items.heading: Write Down Why You Did
items.text: Write down why you did not pass: subjects, exam stress, health, coaching, family pressure or other reasons. The cause changes the plan. If stress or low mood is affecting you, talk to a trusted adult, a teacher or a qualified professional.

items.heading: Pass the Exam While Building
items.text: Pass the exam while building proof of skill so you are not idle.
